dct_description_sm: This data set contains CTDs, and mooring data (salinity, temperature and in some cases PAR and pressure) at a number of depths and locations around La Grande River from 2018-2021. Sensors collected data over the spring melt season, summer seasons and year-long to monitor the extent of the fresh water plume about La Grande River in both ice free and ice present conditions. Mooring data was collected continuously for 4-month and year long periods at 10 or 15 minute intervals at discrete locations and multiple depths.
dct_title_s: Eastern James Bay Moorings and CTDs 2018-2021
